item.tib: dbal gsas drag po sku rdzogs kyi zil gnon lha khrid
item.coloph: 'di la shog ser kha grangs bdun yod/ yig 'phreng mang ba la bcu drug yod/ bco lnga yod/ bcu bzhi yod pa'i shog ser tsha bo la gu ger hrud pa'o/ sprul sku khyung rgod la/ tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis zhus so/ de nas rim gyis brgyud pa'o//
